assumptions: Forecast demand of 17 units/day over the 28-day planning horizon is used for planning.
args.rationale: The trigger recommended ordering 800 units of SKU-1003. Simulation shows that ordering 800 units is infeasible as it violates physical storage capacity (peak occupancy 204.00 m³ exceeds node capacity of 200.00 m³) and exceeds the 12-day max cover policy limit (29.4 days of cover). Baseline projection without a purchase shows 300 units of unmet demand starting on 2026-09-27. Ordering 500 units from SUP-A at $13.00/unit ($6,500.00 total) arriving 2026-09-24 completely resolves the 300 units of unmet demand, respects physical storage capacity (peak occupancy 198.00 m³), and complies with the 12-day max cover policy (ending with 200 units / 11.8 days of cover).
important_factors: Recommended 800 units violates storage capacity (peak occupancy 204 m³ vs 200 m³ limit) and max days of cover policy (29.4 days vs 12 days limit).
500 units completely eliminates all 300 units of unmet demand across the 28-day planning horizon.
500 units stays within physical node capacity (peak occupancy 198 m³) and max days cover policy (11.8 days cover / 200 closing units).
Receipt on 2026-09-24 arrives before the baseline stockout date of 2026-09-27.
